senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חוּג) [to turn,] (denom. of חַג) to celebrate an anniversary, to observe a festival, to make a periodical pilgrimage.
units: Num. R. s. 20 אומה החוֹגֶגֶת וכ׳ a nation that celebrates three pilgrims’ festivals.—Esp. to offer the pilgrim’s festive sacrifice (חֲגִיגָה).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:6">Ḥag. I, 6</cite> <he>מי שלא חַג … חוֹגֵג וכ׳</he> he who failed to offer on the first day …, may do so during the entire festive season.
<cite ref="Pesachim 70b:5">Pes. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>חֲגַגְתֶּם חגיגה</he> you have offered &c.; a. fr.
